repo_summary: Instagram-only AI storytelling pipeline orchestrated by n8n with file-backed prompts, Postgres state, provider adapter scripts, local FFmpeg render worker, Instagram publish/metrics workflows, shell smoke tests, and a local Studio UI.

entrypoint_docs.read_when: Always start here for repo-level agent rules.
Understand the context system and how to use progressive disclosure.
Choose task-specific docs and folders before inspecting implementation files.

Need active direction, awaiting-test items, or known current ambiguities.
